chunks: Neither shady nor protecting against the blazing Fire.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the shade will not protect against the Fire?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the futility of worldly comforts and status for those who neglected divine guidance, illustrating how the very 'shade' they sought in life becomes insufficient against the scorching heat of Hellfire. It serves as a poignant reminder that physical protection or social standing offers no refuge from divine justice on the Day of Resurrection.
